subject: Staggered rollout: warmup-window and quota coordination for AperioLabs pilot
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Maria Rivera <maria@aperiolabs.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Feb 2027 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: Staggered rollout: warmup-window and quota coordination for AperioLabs pilot

Hi Maria / team —

Thanks again for the productive call yesterday. As we discussed, Aperio Labs wants a staged ramp for the pilot to avoid noisy spikes that could trigger global throttles. I pulled together a proposed warmup plan and a couple of product asks so the ops and product teams can size the temporary quota window.

High-level ramp (requested by Aperio):
- Day 1 (pilot start): 1,200 requests/day (~50 req/hr peak)
- Day 2–4: linear ramp to 12k requests/day (peak ~1,000 req/hr)
- Day 5–14: steady-state pilot at 25k–30k requests/day with 10% weekday burst tolerance

Product asks for sizing and confidence:
1) Temporary rate window: we need a dedicated soft quota for the pilot (1.5x expected peak) for first 2 weeks.
2) Prefix caching: enable prefix KV caching for repeated prompt patterns — needs product signoff on config and expected memory footprint.
3) Fallback model policy: specify a lower-cost variant if p95 latency exceeds SLO; ops needs the compatible model id.

Attachments: I’m attaching an initial traffic forecast (aperio_traffic_forecast.xlsx) and a short warmup playbook (warmup_playbook_v1.pdf). Can Lauren and Markus confirm what temporary quota multiple you can support and any product constraints we should relay to Maria?

Next step: propose a 30-min sync (ops + product + customer) tomorrow to lock the numbers.

Thanks —
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Maria Rivera <maria@aperiolabs.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 10:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Staggered rollout: warmup-window and quota coordination for AperioLabs pilot

Jordan / Maria —

Thanks for the clear ramp. A few product notes and clarifications from my side:

- Prefix caching: we can enable prefix/KV caching for the pilot. We’ll need the top 20 prompt templates from Aperio (examples) to estimate cache hit rate and memory. If hit rate > 40% we should see ~25–40% token cost reduction.

- Temporary rate window: product can support a temporary quota at 1.5x expected peak for the first 10 days. After day 10 we prefer manual review before extending. If ops needs >1.5x we’ll need an engineering fast-track (2–3 day lead).

- Model variant fallback: we have a verified faster/quantized variant (model-redwood-q4) that’s compatible for most generation workloads. We need confirmation of quality tolerance — is 2–3% reduction in exact-match acceptable during bursts?

- Observability: please include the warmup runbook link in acceptance criteria; we’ll configure alerting on p95 latency and 5xx rate.

I’m available for the sync tomorrow 11:00–12:30 PST.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
PM, Redwood Console

Date: Tue, 23 Feb 2027 08:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Staggered rollout: warmup-window and quota coordination for AperioLabs pilot

Folks —

From an ops/capacity perspective here are the constraints and proposals: 

- Temporary quota: engineering ops can provision a soft quota set to 1.5x expected peak for up to 14 days without infra changes (we’ll rate-limit per-customer to avoid cross-tenant impact). For anything beyond 1.5x we need a scheduled capacity reservation (lead ~72 hours).

- Sequence length & KV footprint: please confirm expected average and 95th percentile token lengths. If average seq length > 1,200 tokens the KV memory will increase materially; prefix caching should then be scoped to the top user templates only.

- Latency SLO: our fallback trigger will be p95 > 650ms sustained for 3 consecutive 5-min windows. Fallback will route to model-redwood-q4 with reduced context size to keep latency under control.

- Rollout tempo: recommend a 3-bucket warmup window to avoid step spikes:
  * Bucket A (Day 1–2): 10% of expected steady-state traffic
  * Bucket B (Day 3–6): 40%
  * Bucket C (Day 7–14): remaining ramp to steady-state

I can join the sync tomorrow morning. Markus

Subject: Re: Staggered rollout: warmup-window and quota coordination for AperioLabs pilot

Hi Jordan / Lauren / Markus —

Thanks for the fast turn. Confirming Aperio’s ramp details and answers to the questions below: 

- Prompt templates: attached are the top 15 templates we’ll use in pilot — they’re included in the attached forecast spreadsheet. Expect good cacheability for the search-app prompts (~55% hit on repeated prefixes).

- Sequence lengths: average ~420 tokens, p95 ~980 tokens.

- Quality tolerance: we can tolerate a small quality delta during bursts; the 2–3% exact-match loss for model-redwood-q4 is acceptable for fallback windows.

We’re good to proceed with the 3-bucket warmup Markus recommended. Please confirm the sync time and we’ll attend.

—Maria Rivera
Head of Product, Aperio Labs

Attachments: aperio_traffic_forecast.xlsx

Great — thanks everyone for the confirmations. Summary and immediate action items: 

- Temporary quota: ops will grant 1.5x expected peak for 14 days (Markus to provision).
- Prefix/KV caching: Aperio will share the top 15 templates (done). Lauren to estimate memory/cost delta and confirm config by EOD tomorrow.
- Fallback: model-redwood-q4 approved as fallback when p95 > 650ms for >=3 windows.
- Rollout buckets: agreed to Markus’s 3-bucket approach.

Action owners & deadlines:
- Markus Klein: provision 1.5x soft quota and confirm provisioning time (by 02/25 10:00 PST).
- Lauren Bishop: provide prefix caching config + expected cost delta (by 02/25 17:00 PST).
- Marissa Cole: create the runbook and add alert thresholds to the warmup doc (JIRA INF-4123).
- Jordan Blake / Maria Rivera: coordinate final sync and signoff (schedule for 02/25).

Links: Drive doc with forecast & runbook: https://drive.google.com/aperio-warmup; HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567; JIRA INF-4123

I’ll schedule the 30-min sync for Thu 02/25 09:30 PST — invite forthcoming.

Thanks —
Jordan
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
